Alytus Jewish Cemetery 2

Jewish Cemetery · Alytaus apskritis, Lithuania

Not demolished. This is the Jewish cemetery of Alytus II, part of a Jewish community considered among the oldest in Lithuania, traceable to the 16th century. Between August 13 and September 9, 1941, 1,137 Jewish men, women, and children were murdered in the nearby Vidzgiris forest, alongside Jews from Czechoslovakia and tens of thousands of Soviet civilians and prisoners of war. This cemetery was completely destroyed, with various buildings now standing on the site, though a section of its original brick fence has survived; its oldest tombstone dated to 1852.
